headlines.snippet: After about two and a half weeks of searching, the body of missing Israeli Amichai Yogev, who disappeared in Greece, was found. headlines.snippet: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize will be awarded to South African jurist Navi Pillay, who determined that Israel is committing genocide. A representative of the prize committee stated her stance on Israel was a significant reason for her selection.

headlines.snippet: Following the controversy over "Zionism is Racism," the leader of the Green Party in the UK lost his election and will not serve in Parliament. The British Prime Minister had criticized the party's decision as "completely wrong."

headlines.snippet: It has been released that Captain Eliav Chaim Tzeflamos fell in southern Lebanon. Tzeflamos, an engineer in the Nahal Brigade of the IDF, was killed when an armored personnel carrier overturned near the Litani River. headlines.snippet: South African judge Navi Pillay, who determined that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza, has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. Pillay previously served as president of the International Criminal Court in The Hague and headed a UN commission investigating human rights violations in the Palestinian territories. In a report published a year ago, she wrote that Israel was responsible for a "murderous campaign" to destroy the Palestinian people in Gaza. Israel responded sharply, calling it "Goebbels applauding from hell."

headlines.snippet: The leader of the Jewish party that declared "Zionism is Racism" lost an election in the UK. Despite the loss, Goldsmith indicated he has no intention of resigning as leader of the Green Party.
